why: All nine articles report the same single event: Malki Kawa's one social-media video answering Ali Abdelaziz's Pound 4 Pound podcast prediction about Usman Nurmagomedov vs Topuria; the same quotes (annihilate 100% of your roster, would beat Gaethje in a rematch, bad night, still No. 1) appear in every piece across outlets and languages.

substories.description: Kawa fires back at Abdelaziz in a social-media video over the Nurmagomedov-beats-Topuria prediction
